observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden table with drawers open, revealing spools of thread and tools. Photo 1 shows the same sewing machine and table with the top closed. The machine is centered on the table, which has a single drawer with a brass handle and a small round knob on the right side. A blue fabric is draped over the table, and a laptop is visible on the left edge.
The machine appears to be a manual treadle model, not electric, with a large handwheel and foot pedal. The brand name is not clearly visible in either photo.
The table has a wooden finish with visible wear and scratches. The drawers are open in photo 0, showing contents; in photo 1, the drawer is closed.

The seller claims 'Butterfly sewing machine with table extension and mini drawers'. The table has drawers, but no visible extension is shown. The machine is described as 'in excellent condition', but there is visible wear on the table and some dust on the machine.
